facts.statement: Players who redeemed SOE Pre-Paid PC Game Cards bought from participating European retailers received Double Station Cash during the promotion window.
facts.quote: Redeem SOE Pre-Paid Game Cards anytime between October 7th, 2011 and October 10th, 2011 to get Double SC*.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (European Double Station Cash)
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post announcing that SOE Pre-Paid Game Cards went on sale at European retailers, with a promotion giving Double Station Cash (SC) to players who redeem those cards between October 7 and October 10, 2011. The post is a short promo notice; it describes no quests, items or mechanics beyond the Station Cash bonus. The posting date is not shown; it is only given relative to the capture (posted 2 days, 2 hours ago).
